title: osf review: multi-agent PR review pipeline
summary: Adds a headless, multi-reviewer pull-request review pipeline to osf. A change is assessed for risk, a catalogue of 20 review lenses is selected against the changed paths and earned signals, and each configured coding agent (codex, claude, opencode, omp) runs in a clean read-only copy of the change with only its own credential. Answers are validated against a JSON Schema, their quoted findings are checked against the real files, and a deterministic reducer turns them into a per-lens and whole-review verdict that is journalled and posted. A new GitHub workflow builds osf from the base branch and runs each reviewer in its own job, with the deciding job alone holding the posting token.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: pull_request_target
nodes.summary: Builds osf from the base branch with no secrets, then runs each reviewer in its own job with only its own provider key and network host, then a final job that collects saved answers, decides, and posts.

nodes.label: review build
nodes.subtitle: base branch only
nodes.summary: Checks out the base branch, builds the osf binary in the devcontainer, and uploads it as an artifact. Holds no secret.

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: One job per reviewer. Mounts the base and the pull request read-only, passes only that reviewer's key, and runs `osf review run --reviewer <name> --out`.

nodes.label: review reduce job
nodes.subtitle: decides and posts
nodes.summary: Collects every reviewer's saved answers, mints the verifier app token, and runs `osf review reduce --post-to`. Runs even when a reviewer job failed; a missing answer counts as could-not-run.

nodes.label: review-fork-disabled
nodes.subtitle: fails loudly
nodes.summary: A fork pull request with OSF_REVIEW_FORKS unset fails rather than skipping, so it cannot pass the check by leaving fork review unconfigured.

nodes.label: review run
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Selects lenses, runs the roster over each, checks findings, decides, journals, and optionally posts. `--reviewer` runs one reviewer and saves its run.

nodes.label: review reduce
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Reads the saved reviewer files, re-validates each answer, checks quotes, journals, and posts.

nodes.label: agents list
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Prints every agent osf can drive with what `[agents]` in osf.toml selects: enabled, builder, reviewer, model, hook settings.

nodes.label: scan --no-suppress
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: CI now scans with every osf-disable marker ignored, so a suppression cannot hide a finding from the gate.

nodes.label: lenses
nodes.subtitle: catalogue + selection
nodes.summary: Loads the 20 shipped lenses, an organisation folder, and the repository's `.osf/review-lenses/`, then selects the lenses a change earns by tier, path trigger, or signal trigger.

nodes.label: changeset_risk
nodes.subtitle: tier + signals
nodes.summary: Now also reads diff content to earn review-lens signals: public surface, concurrency, new-file, repeated-logic, high-traffic path.

nodes.label: review_context
nodes.subtitle: prompt metadata + change folder
nodes.summary: Builds the metadata section of a reviewer's prompt, writes the diff and commit log into a read-only folder, and redacts secrets before either leaves osf.

nodes.label: review_prompt
nodes.subtitle: template + answer format
nodes.summary: Fills the shipped or repository prompt template with the lens, its questions, the severity guide and the metadata, then appends the fixed answer format.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: orchestration
nodes.summary: Runs the roster over the selected lenses, saves each reviewer's run, and reduces saved runs into a verdict. Owns the round and critical-round policy.

nodes.label: reviewers
nodes.subtitle: roster + headless run
nodes.summary: Builds the reviewer roster from `[agents]` and runs one agent headless in a fresh home with only its own login and credential, under a timeout.

nodes.label: answer
nodes.subtitle: schema + extraction
nodes.summary: Validates a reviewer's answer against the review-answer JSON Schema, the lens name, and every criterion score; extracts JSON from fenced blocks when the whole message is not JSON.

nodes.label: quotes
nodes.subtitle: quote verification
nodes.summary: Checks each finding's quote against the file and line it names, within a two-line tolerance, and builds the only VerifiedAnswer the reducer can score.

nodes.label: reducer
nodes.subtitle: verdict rules
nodes.summary: Turns verified answers into a per-lens verdict (quorum, blockers, mean of means) and a whole-review verdict (weighted mean against the threshold). No model call.

nodes.label: builder
nodes.subtitle: builder family detection
nodes.summary: Reads each commit's Code-Generator trailer to name the model families that built the change, so a reviewer from the builder's own family sits the change out.

nodes.label: clean_copy
nodes.subtitle: settings-free checkout
nodes.summary: Copies the change's tracked and untracked files into a temp folder, leaving out every coding agent's project settings and every symlink.

nodes.label: secret_values
nodes.subtitle: held-secret scrub
nodes.summary: Removes the exact values of the secrets this job holds from reviewer-written text before it is saved or shown.

nodes.label: journal
nodes.subtitle: ReviewAnswer + ReviewDecision
nodes.summary: Two new journal payloads record each reviewer answer and the whole review decision; the transcript path is dropped from the replay hash.

nodes.label: agents
nodes.subtitle: the one agent list
nodes.summary: Each agent now carries its family, command, hook wiring, project settings, and what running it as a reviewer needs: read-only mode, schema flag, credential env, login paths.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: codex exec
nodes.summary: Runs read-only in a sandbox, takes `--output-schema`, and reads CODEX_API_KEY.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: claude --print
nodes.summary: Restricted to Read/Grep/Glob with no shell, takes `--json-schema` inline, and its answer sits under the envelope's structured_output.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: opencode run
nodes.summary: Denies edits and every command through OPENCODE_PERMISSION, and reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

nodes.label: omp
nodes.subtitle: omp
nodes.summary: Limited to read, grep and glob tools, with project extensions, skills and rules turned off.

nodes.label: dsh
nodes.subtitle: dsh --profile headless
nodes.summary: Documents no read-only mode, so it never starts as a reviewer; it remains the default builder.

nodes.label: pull request
nodes.subtitle: owner/repo#N
nodes.summary: The change under review, and the place the review is posted as inline comments and a summary.

nodes.label: verifier app token
nodes.subtitle: create-github-app-token
nodes.summary: Minted only in the deciding job, with pull-requests write and contents read, so no reviewer job can post.

flows.title: One reviewer's run over one lens
flows.summary: How a single reviewer job turns a change into a saved, schema-validated answer: build the metadata, write the diff into a read-only folder, copy the change into a settings-free folder, render the prompt, run the agent headless, and validate its output.

messages.label: select lenses for the change
messages.note: Tier, path triggers and earned signals decide which of the 20 lenses run.

messages.label: write change.diff, read-only
messages.note: The commit log and the full diff go into a read-only temp folder the reviewer reads with file tools.

response.shape: temp folder, no agent settings, no symlinks

messages.label: render prompt + answer format
messages.note: The template is filled with the lens, its questions, the severity guide and the metadata; the fixed answer format is appended.

messages.label: codex exec --sandbox read-only --output-schema
messages.note: The agent runs in a fresh home with only its own login and credential, under a timeout killed through kill_tree.

messages.label: save ReviewerRun to --out
messages.note: The saved file holds each attempt's validated answer, its round and its critical flag; nothing is journalled or posted here.

flows.title: Reducing saved answers to a posted verdict
flows.summary: How the deciding job turns every reviewer's saved file into one verdict: bind each file to its reviewer, re-validate each answer, check every quoted finding against the real files, decide each lens and the whole review, journal, and post.

messages.label: bind each file to its reviewer
messages.note: A file counts only when its name is a plain reviewer name, matches the run's own reviewer, and is unique.

messages.label: revalidate each answer against schema and lens
messages.note: A saved answer is checked again the way a reviewer's own run checked it; nothing vouches for the file.

messages.label: append ReviewAnswer per attempt
messages.note: The journal carries scores, counts and a reason, never a prompt or a raw answer.

messages.label: append ReviewDecision
messages.note: The decision records the verdict, each lens's outcome, the score and threshold, and the builder families.

messages.label: post inline comments + summary
messages.note: A failed post makes the run could-not-run, so the gate never sees a clean exit with no review evidence.
